verdict.rationale: Docs confirm each merchant has a configurable 'payout speed' visible/manageable in the Dashboard, implying per-seller payout timing, but there is no detail on specific schedule options (daily/weekly/monthly/manual) or instant payouts to cards/real-time rails. Missing for 10: explicit list of supported payout frequencies, instant/real-time payout rail support, and per-seller configuration UI/API details beyond a single 'speed' setting.
